node.title: Code expressions in regex refer to the regex group captured, by name / relative
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
How do our code evaluations in regex refer to the regex group captured, by name and/or relative way ? Try such
'foo' =~ /(?'name'(?=o)(\w+))(?{print $name})/ # or 'foo' =~ /(?'name'(?=o)(\w+))(?{print $-1})/ Number found where operator expected at (eval 23) to only get failure.
How is the correct Perl's way ?
